actors.name: Péter Magyar

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Javier Milei faces intense focus following a sharp diplomatic fallout with Brazilian President Lula da Silva, who excluded him from his upcoming inauguration. Concurrently, Milei hosted Polish President Karol Nawrocki in Buenos Aires, traveled to Paraguay for presidential talks, and faced domestic legislative battles over the 2027 budget amid technical recession reports.

actors.name: Jair Bolsonaro
